description: Hand cases for the strategy.* rows (PL.native-genre-rows slice 3): what core's corpora conformance/strategy/ leave unpinned — the contract, campaignForWorld over a world's own section and the row's over it, the tunables absent, null, partial and whole, an empty world, campaignFacts, campaignWorldFacts and settlementAdjacency alone, turnBooks, claimCost and controlledSettlements at their edges, the save block's defaults, duplicates and refusals, ids naming Object.prototype members, the [invalid-input] boundary of every declared member of every argument, directors over their own KB (before the start, refusals as values, two turns' books and orders, a restore mid-game), and a director's kb carrying the facts its verdicts read. Every expectation is computed by core's own functions at the pin (gen-bridge-strategy-cases.mts, kept with the builder's record).
